central_statement: For an additive commutative group G and h:G->R with |h(2P)-4h(P)|<=C uniformly, C>=0, the normalized sequence h(2^n P)/4^n converges for every P, its limit differs from h(P) by at most C/3, and the limit obeys H(2P)=4H(P).
elliptic_bridge: Apply Mathlib's approx_parallelogram_law for elliptic naiveHeight to obtain an unspecified uniform doubling-defect constant, then instantiate the limit statement on actual elliptic points.
proof_gate: Pin Lean and Mathlib manifest, build the actual theorem module, print axioms for every declaration, no sorry/admit/custom research axiom/native evaluation.
boundary: This constructs the abstract canonical-height limit and an existential comparison constant; the explicit curve-specific Silverman bound B<14, Mordell-Weil generator and reduction map are separate obligations.
resource_cap: Local Lean compilation and read-only Mathlib inspection, no Sage or cloud spend.
